heading: ‘They fed me samosa’: Bengaluru CEO uses Gemini, dashcam to outsmart a road rage biker
author: LiveMint Editorial
paragraphs: Initially inclined to let the matter go for his own peace of mind, the CEO changed his stance after noticing the deep dent left on his car. Figuring that a lesson needed to be taught, he approached the Koramangala police station armed with the video evidence.
